method: Exact conjugacy; log-gamma PMF; independent rational ordered-path enumeration and SciPy references

provenance.population: Comparable repairs under unchanged service conditions
provenance.classification: Status at seven days; replacement overrides revisit; otherwise resolved
provenance.horizon: Next three completed repairs assessed at the same seven-day horizon
provenance.prior_basis: Stipulated teaching prior, not elicited or estimated from the eight jobs

metrics.batch_comparison_condition: Both groups have size 3; independent batch vectors assume fixed shapes (7,4,1); no hierarchy fitted

limitations: Fictional illustration with a stipulated prior; no operational service recommendation or empirical calibration claim.
One common probability vector assumes conditional independence and stable, exhaustive, exclusive categories.
The Dirichlet is restricted to positive shapes; a structural zero requires an explicitly reduced support model.
A marginal Dirichlet-multinomial alone cannot identify uncertainty versus physical batch heterogeneity.
Independent batch comparison fixes hyperparameters; learning shared hyperparameters also induces cross-batch dependence.
Enumeration is for small totals; no MCMC or random simulation is required and the seed is metadata only.
